title: Ultra Fast Optimization
description: This is a concise and high-performance optimization modpack, aiming to support those less commonly used Minecraft versions.
body:
## Introduction
This modpack is dedicated to improving the performance of those less commonly used Minecraft versions, delivering more FPS and a smoother experience for players. On the 1.20.6 Fabric version, it boosts frame rates by 170%–220% compared to vanilla.

The modpack can also serve as a foundation—you can add more mods on top of it, or even create your own modpack based on it.
